name: King step
text: Step 1 in any of the 8 directions.

name: Knight leap
text: Jump to one of the 8 (1,2)/(2,1) offsets, ignoring pieces in between.

name: Rook slide
text: Slide orthogonally up to N tiles (N is shown as pips).

name: Bishop slide
text: Slide diagonally up to N tiles.

name: Queen slide
text: Slide in any of the 8 directions up to N tiles.

name: Pawn
text: Moves 1 orthogonally in any direction, strikes 1 diagonally in any direction.

name: Flying
text: Added to a slide: passes over pieces and obstacles and lands on an enterable empty tile; ignores Rubble and Hot Wax while passing.

name: Artillery
text: Hits a tile within a min-max distance, ignoring line of sight.

name: Ranged line
text: Shoots along a line and hits the first piece.
